# Daily Dashboard V0.4.2

## Release scope

- Silent Windows updates now relaunch Daily Dashboard after the NSIS installer has finished writing the new application and shortcuts.
- Relaunching happens inside the installer’s post-install phase, so it targets the new versioned executable rather than retaining the previous executable path.
- Both **Install now** and **Install next sign-in** use the same post-install relaunch behaviour.
- Retains all V0.4.1 ambient-display, map, slideshow, private-repository updater, scaling, calendar, ADS-B, and weather improvements.

## Updating from V0.4.1

V0.4.2 is versioned above V0.4.1 and will be offered by the in-app updater. Because `BananaAficionado/DailyDashboard` is private, enter a fine-grained GitHub token with **Contents: read** access under **Settings → Application updates**. After the verified installer completes, the updated application opens automatically.

## Verification

- `npm run build`
- `npm test`
- `npm run test:responsive`
- `cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml`
- Windows x64 production cross-compilation
- Tagged Windows NSIS installer workflow
